comments.body:
A bounded provenance finding in the published Worker05 correction is recorded before fixing it: **CATALASE-PROVENANCE-001**. The Catalase proposal says that JCM117 directly supplies the historical C-10 spelling and 60 mg addition. Its declared direct JCM117 capture instead says “Nothing found.” The separate TOGO M109 capture supplies `original_media_id: JCM_M117`, literal `Catalase (Sigma C--10)`, 60 mg and filtration context.

Correct the attribution to [TOGO M109](https://togomedium.org/medium/M109) and disclose the unsuccessful direct JCM lookup. Preserve the historical catalog spelling, all raw source/history, the distinct verified C9322 product, and the unresolved historical species/C100-equivalence holds. This changes provenance wording, not chemical identity or source transcription. Deduplication read the full current bodies/comments of #1193 and #1201; neither already records this exact finding.

Exact finding: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/integration/final-same-target-reconciliation-v1/finding-catalase-provenance-v1/finding.json`, SHA256 `63159e7a7ce6be15a20f35ae62c42e2e9aabc55b3f319e1c4b688c17a86e2a4f`. No maintained candidate has been applied. The successor requires independent review.

For clarified rumen fluid, the evidence supports withdrawing the cow-only exact MICRO:0000520 identity. Preserve the authentic record as an explicitly species-unspecified, variable processed-fluid local material, retaining separate source preparation descriptions. This scope does not assert equivalence of species, protocols or batch compositions. DSMZ sources permit cow or sheep; the cited JCM preparations do not specify species. MICRO:0001898 is specifically the DSMZ1310 preparation and cannot identify the generic/JCM owner. Supersede the W02 exact-520 support explicitly; retain original history as history.

The three incoming components in Casitone_Yeast_Extract_Rumen_Fluid, PY-glucose-rumen_Fluid and PYG_Rumen_Fluid require a distinct correction. Prior #204 comments already warn that their source labels say only rumen fluid. Redirecting their IDs to a local **clarified** owner keeps the unsupported processing assertion. The bounded correction is literal `component_name: rumen fluid`, `reference_scope: UNMAPPED`, no unsupported component_id, and preserved source-specific uncertainty/history. A generic UBERON grounding would require separate evidence review; it is not implicitly approved. This conclusion does not settle the separate sludge-fluid scope.

Sources: [MicrO0000520](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/micro/terms?obo_id=MICRO:0000520), [MicrO0001898](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/micro/terms?obo_id=MICRO:0001898), [DSMZ161](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/rest/medium/161), [DSMZ212](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/rest/medium/212), [JCM266](https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=266), [prior #204 conclusion](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/204#issuecomment-5208800239).

Independent full-owner scope review is recorded in `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/existing-owner-scope-decisions-v1/`; decisions SHA256 `150af7315aa6688d4bc9adb3e2a27d0a0835ec8f8ac33d65b8951712b0382d81`, manifest `c664e35067692c0aa46c4570ec688ffba9281e692337cfa5de1e4f014dc2ce54`. The coordinator rehashed all 89 manifest members. This is a sourced conclusion for candidate preparation; final exact candidate bytes still require native validation and independent review. No maintained records or approvals have changed.

The Phytone identity question is sufficiently supported for a bounded correction: retain the authentic Phytone record and use specific **MICRO:0001795, Phytone peptone**. The official term identifies the BBL/Difco trademark and cites the manufacturer definition; TOGO M2989 explicitly names the BBL product. The manufacturer's guide distinguishes this product from Phytone UF, Soytone and other soy products. The erroneous `Hordeum vulgare` parenthetical in ontology annotation is a known limitation, not evidence that this product is barley-derived.

Couple this with source-preserving nonresolving dispositions for three tokens on Soy_Peptone: `Phytone peptone`, `Phytone peptone (BD-BBL)`, and `Soytone (BD-Difco) or Phytone peptone (BD-BBL)`. The third expresses alternatives. Do not merge owners, copy shared-ID occurrence memberships, or treat export suppression alone as a repair of false exact synonyms. Other Soy/Corn claims remain within their own review scope.

Sources: [official MicrO term](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/micro/terms?obo_id=MICRO:0001795), [TOGO M2989](https://togomedium.org/medium/M2989), [manufacturer guide](https://documents.thermofisher.com/TFS-Assets/BPD/brochures/peptones-supplements-feeds-technical-reference-guide.pdf).

Independent full-owner scope review is recorded in `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/existing-owner-scope-decisions-v1/`; decisions SHA256 `150af7315aa6688d4bc9adb3e2a27d0a0835ec8f8ac33d65b8951712b0382d81`, manifest `c664e35067692c0aa46c4570ec688ffba9281e692337cfa5de1e4f014dc2ce54`. The coordinator rehashed all 89 manifest members. This is a sourced conclusion for candidate preparation; final exact candidate bytes still require native validation and independent review. No maintained records or approvals have changed.

The original owner can retain **BD-Difco** continuity: its creation history identifies MediaDive1769, whose captured uses name BD-Difco; current JCM481, 482 and 612 independently name BD-Difco RCM. Prepare a supplier-qualified local identity on that authentic owner. Keep the manufacturer nine-part approximate formulation scoped to its cited product/formula; do not infer more specific peptones, salt hydrates or invariant lot composition.

The NBRC902 occurrence explicitly naming **Oxoid CM0149** needs a separate, deduplicated supplier-specific owner. Its historical formula revision is unknown. The current Oxoid IFU's formula differs from the Difco table, and must not be backdated onto that old occurrence. Bare RCM and mixed-supplier alternatives remain unresolved; preserve all raw strings/history without globally routing generic aliases to either product. Additional water, agar and sea salts in receiving media are not automatically constituents of the purchased dry product. The existing Dehydrated_RCM_Medium scope must be checked during deduplication, not silently absorbed.

Sources: [MediaDive1769](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/ingredients/1769), [JCM481](https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=481), [NBRC902](https://www.nite.go.jp/nbrc/catalogue/NBRCMediumDetailServlet?NO=902), [Oxoid IFU](https://assets.thermofisher.com/TFS-Assets/MBD/Instructions/MBD_BT_IFU-0539%20CM0149B%20REINFORCED%20CLOSTRIDIAL%20MEDIUM.pdf), [Difco/BBL manual excerpt](https://cdn.media.interlabdist.com.br/uploads/2021/01/Reinforced-Clostridial-Medium.pdf).

The coordinator rehashed all 89 manifest members. This is a sourced conclusion for candidate preparation; final exact candidate bytes still require native validation and independent review. No maintained records or approvals have changed.
